text: Travel experiences can be exciting and life-changing. When planning a trip, it is important to research your destination, book your transport, and make a list of things you want to see. Travelling lets you discover new cultures, try delicious local food, and meet people from different backgrounds. Sometimes you may face language barriers, but you can use simple words, gestures, or translation apps to communicate. These challenges often make the journey more interesting. In the end, the best part of travelling is the memories you create, which stay with you long after you return home.
